A site with an RV may add two tents; 8 people per site.

values.note: Two heated shower buildings with flush toilets, plus several pit toilets; water fill-up stations through the campground and two disposal stations. Beach house and concession stand at the Resort Lake swimming beach.

values.note: Booked online on the county's own reservation site (site-by-site availability calendar) or at (906) 753-4582. Cancellations 7+ days out are refunded as credit, less the $10 fee; none inside 7 days. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm.

note: Menominee County park of 240 acres among four lakes (Resort, East, Baker and Bass) near the Menominee River, north of Stephenson off County Road G-12 and River Road. Boat launches on Resort Lake and Bass Lake, a sand swimming beach on Resort Lake, two-plus miles of hiking trails along the lakes. --Claude
summary: County park page + its booking site (134 site pages): season May 1 - Nov 30 (confirmed), 138 sites (confirmed), 50-amp (confirmed), showers (confirmed) + flush toilets, water fill stations, two dump stations (confirmed); new: max 50 ft, pull-throughs, reservable on the county's own Konect booking site, $10 reservation fee (confirmed), $5/day vehicle entrance.
